body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Lisbon, Portugal. It starts at Avenida Eusébio da Silva Ferreira.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Explore the Estádio da Luz to see why football has so much fan following in Portugal.
>
> Gain entry with key stops where a guide is available for questions.
>
> Start the tour at Portugal's largest stadium, opened in 2003. Walk by the field, visit the locker rooms and press areas, and take a photo with Sport Lisboa e Benfica's eagle.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €24.74. It was rated 4.9 out of 5 from 23 ratings and 9 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
